name: org.mozilla.gecko.process.GeckoChildProcessServices$zygoteTab
description: Mozilla GeckoView, including the CENO Developers fork for CENO Browser, starts this Service on Android 10 or later when app-zygote mode is enabled and it needs an isolated process for web page content. This process runs the Gecko child that handles the page.
disableEffect: If app-zygote mode is enabled, disabling this Service can prevent GeckoView from starting isolated page processes, so affected tabs may fail to load; when the mode is off, GeckoView does not select this Service.
